text: Experience Required: 15+ years in leading architectural design firms. Qualification: B.Arch / M.Arch Key Requirements: • Minimum 15 years of professional experience in leading architectural design firm. • Strong expertise in conceptualization, master planning, and schematic design development for large and complex projects. • Proven ability to independently lead projects from concept stage through schematic and detailed design stages. • Strong design sensibility with innovative and practical problem-solving skills. • Experience in managing client interactions, presentations, and multidisciplinary coordination. • Proficiency in Revit, SketchUp, Adobe Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, Premiere Pro), Lumion/Enscape, and Rhino/Grasshopper. • Exposure to large-scale projects such as mixed-use developments, institutional, commercial, hospitality, urban design, or infrastructure projects will be preferred. Role Responsibilities: • Lead the conceptual design process and develop design strategies for large-scale projects. • Prepare and oversee schematic design packages. • Present design concepts to clients and key stakeholders. • Guide internal design teams and ensure overall design quality. • Coordinate with structural, MEP, and specialist consultants. • Ensure project designs align with client requirements, design intent, and statutory norms. At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!
